_comment: Generic, vertical-agnostic assistant template. One JSON per business is generated from this by scripts/generate-assistant-config.ts, which merges: (1) this template, (2) the business's row in `businesses`/`locations`, (3) the vertical-specific system prompt from vapi-templates/prompts/<vertical>.md, (4) a voice/model override if the business has one. POST the result to https://api.vapi.ai/assistant (create) or PATCH .../assistant/{id} (update). Verify field names against current Vapi docs before importing — this API evolves.
name: {{business_name}} Voice Assistant
firstMessage: Thanks for calling {{business_name}}! This is our virtual assistant — how can I help you today?
voicemailMessage: Hi, this is the virtual assistant for {{business_name}}. Sorry we couldn't take your call — please call back during business hours or leave a message after the tone.

server._comment: Same URL + secret for every business — /webhooks/vapi resolves the caller's business/location from call.assistantId and call.phoneNumberId server-side. Do NOT create one webhook URL per business; that doesn't scale to 100+ tenants and duplicates the tenant-resolution logic that already lives in tenantResolver.ts.

messages.content: One moment while I look that up.

function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Check whether the caller is an existing customer/patient/client by phone or email. Call this as soon as you have either.

phone.description: Caller's phone number, digits as spoken

messages.content: Let me check that time for you.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check whether a specific appointment start time is free, before offering to book it.

start_iso.description: Proposed start time, full ISO-8601 datetime

messages.content: Let me get that tentatively held for you.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Tentatively book an appointment. Only call once you have the caller's name, phone, requested service, and a specific date/time. It checks availability internally.

messages.content: Give me one second to pull that up.

function.name: cancel_or_reschedule_appointment
function.description: Cancel or reschedule the caller's existing appointment. Short-notice changes are automatically routed to staff instead of made immediately — you'll be told which happened.

function.name: log_emergency
function.description: Log an urgent issue for immediate staff follow-up. Call this immediately whenever the caller describes an emergency (definition varies by business — see system prompt).

function.name: request_human_handoff
function.description: Escalate to staff for direct follow-up, e.g. when the caller asks for a person or you can't help.

function.name: business_hours
function.description: Check current open/closed status and today's hours. Prefer this over guessing.

function.name: faq_lookup
function.description: Look up a general question (hours, location, pricing, policies, services) not already covered by your built-in knowledge base. Prefer answering from your own knowledge first.

knowledgeBase._comment: RECOMMENDED: upload this business's docs via Vapi's native Knowledge Base / File Search feature instead of relying solely on faq_lookup — avoids an extra webhook + vector DB round trip per question. Keep faq_lookup as the fallback for anything the native KB misses.
